import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class MinCostFlow {
        int nodeCount;
        long INF_FLOW = (long) 1e9;
        long[] priority, potential, currentFlow;
        int[] prevEdge, prevNode;
        PriorityQueue<Pair> pq;
        List<List<Edge>> graph;

        class Edge {
            int to, rev;
            long flow, capacity;
            long cost;

            Edge(int to, int rev, long flow, long capacity, long cost) {
                this.to = to;
                this.rev = rev;
                this.flow = flow;
                this.capacity = capacity;
                this.cost = cost;
            }
        }

        class Pair implements Comparable<Pair> {
            long dist;
            int node;

            Pair(long dist, int node) {
                this.dist = dist;
                this.node = node;
            }

            public int compareTo(Pair other) {
                return Long.compare(this.dist, other.dist);
            }
        }

        MinCostFlow(int n) {
            this.nodeCount = n;
            priority = new long[n];
            potential = new long[n];
            currentFlow = new long[n];
            prevEdge = new int[n];
            prevNode = new int[n];
            graph = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                graph.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            pq = new PriorityQueue<>();
        }

        void addEdge(int s, int t, long cap, long cst) {
            graph.get(s).add(new Edge(t, graph.get(t).size(), 0, cap, cst));
            graph.get(t).add(new Edge(s, graph.get(s).size() - 1, 0, 0, -cst));
        }

        Pair computeFlow(int s, int t) {
            long totalFlow = 0;
            long totalCost = 0;
            while (true) {
                Arrays.fill(priority, INF_FLOW);
                priority[s] = 0;
                currentFlow[s] = INF_FLOW;
                pq.clear();
                pq.add(new Pair(0, s));
                while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                    Pair current = pq.poll();
                    long dist = current.dist;
                    int u = current.node;
                    if (dist != priority[u]) continue;
                    for (int i = 0; i < graph.get(u).size(); i++) {
                        Edge e = graph.get(u).get(i);
                        int v = e.to;
                        if (e.capacity <= e.flow) continue;
                        long newPriority = priority[u] + e.cost + potential[u] - potential[v];
                        if (priority[v] > newPriority) {
                            priority[v] = newPriority;
                            pq.add(new Pair(newPriority, v));
                            prevNode[v] = u;
                            prevEdge[v] = i;
                            currentFlow[v] = Math.min(currentFlow[u], e.capacity - e.flow);
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (priority[t] == INF_FLOW) break;
                for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; i++) {
                    potential[i] += priority[i];
                }
                long delta = Math.min(currentFlow[t], INF_FLOW - totalFlow);
                totalFlow += delta;
                for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevNode[v]) {
                    Edge e = graph.get(prevNode[v]).get(prevEdge[v]);
                    e.flow += delta;
                    graph.get(v).get(e.rev).flow -= delta;
                    totalCost += delta * e.cost;
                }
            }
            return new Pair(totalFlow, totalCost);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int T = 500;
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        int N = n * T;
        MinCostFlow mcf = new MinCostFlow(N + 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < T - 1; j++) {
                mcf.addEdge(i * T + j, i * T + j + 1, mcf.INF_FLOW, c);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < T; i++) {
            mcf.addEdge(i, N + 1, mcf.INF_FLOW, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            mcf.addEdge(N, x * T, 1, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int y = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < T - 1; j++) {
                int cur = 1;
                for (int _ = 0; _ < k; _++) {
                    mcf.addEdge(x * T + j, y * T + j + 1, 1, cur * d + c);
                    mcf.addEdge(y * T + j, x * T + j + 1, 1, cur * d + c);
                    cur += 2;
                }
            }
        }
        MinCostFlow.Pair result = mcf.computeFlow(N, N + 1);
        if (result.dist != k) {
            throw new AssertionError();
        }
        System.out.println(result.cost);
        sc.close();
    }
}
